===Objectives===
*Go to the ruins of [[Ashford Village|Ashford]] and defeat [[Ignis Phanaura]].
*Return to [[Vassar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* 50 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Power Leak}}
*{{skill icon|Conjure Phantasm}}

*{{skill icon|Imagined Burden}}

==Walkthrough==
[[Ignis Phanaura]] will be a short distance south of the [[Sardelac Sanitarium]], accompanied by two other gargoyles.

===Foes===
====Bosses====
[[Gargoyle]]s
* {{me}} 6 (26) [[Ignis Phanaura]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"So you would like to use your skills to help out around here?  We can always use more capable souls to join us in our struggle.  South of the Sanitarium through the ruins of '''Ashford''' is a foul gargoyle named '''Ignis Phanaura''' that pretends at being a Mesmer.  He has been the cause of much suffering these past two years.  Destroy him and the people of Ascalon will benefit greatly from your actions."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I will slay this gargoyle.
| decline = Perhaps I don't want to be a Mesmer.
| ask = Slay Ignis, he is south through the ruins of Ashford.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"Ignis was a foul creature; you have done all of Ascalon a great service this day.  I must say, you show some real potential for this work."''

==Notes==
*Combines well with [[Trying Times]] as Ignis will be along the way.
